A '''Crystal transmitter''' was a hidden transmission device employed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Danu]] during the [[Drogheda Civil War]]. She used it to communicate with the [[Drogheda Revolutionaries]] undetected, as she was spying within the [[Drogheda Citadel]], and needed to remain inconspicuous. The transmitter was worn around the woman's neck, where she was able to pass it off as a necklace.
